text: This report recommends the award of the Request for Tender for Washroom Renovation - Simba and Canadian Domain Zoomobile Station.

The Board of Management of the Toronto Zoo: 1. Approved the Request for Tender-39 - Washroom Renovation - Simba and Canadian Domain Zoomobile Station at Toronto Zoo. 2. Awarded the project to Norfield Construction Inc., in the amount of $642,773.05 excluding applicable taxes.
